sv.title: Frankrike behöver banta 67 miljarder till
sv.summary: Frankrike kan behöva spara minst 6 miljarder euro, motsvarande 67,1 miljarder kronor, ytterligare nästa år. Det sa budgetministern David Amiel i en intervju med Sud Radio, skriver BFM Business.

en.title: France needs to cut another 67 billion
en.summary: France may need to cut at least 6 billion euros, equivalent to SEK 67.1 billion, further next year. Budget minister David Amiel said this in an interview with Sud Radio, BFM Business reports.
